name: Crude Oil
description: Crude oil links production, storage, pipelines, ports, tanker routes, refineries, inventories, and end demand. This page distinguishes WTI from Brent and physical grades.

benchmark.name: NYMEX WTI Crude Oil futures
benchmark.delayPolicy: Provider-defined; use the displayed as-of timestamp.
benchmark.caveat: WTI futures are not interchangeable with Brent or every physical crude grade.

marketContext: Read WTI beside Brent, regional physical grades, inventories, refinery runs, pipeline constraints, tanker routes, and producer policy. A disruption may matter differently by location and delivery month. The benchmark can also move with currencies, interest rates, or broad risk positioning even when physical flows have not changed.
